name: devops-mailer
description: Send custom SMTP email to one or more recipients with Handlebars template support for Azure Pipelines.
helpMarkDown: Use this task to send an email from Azure Pipelines through SMTP. Subject and content support Handlebars templates using pipeline variables and custom JSON template context.
author: DevOps Mailer

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Logical message title. Available in templates as {{title}}.

inputs.name: to
inputs.label: To Adresses
inputs.helpMarkDown: Recipient emails. Separate with comma, semicolon, or newline.

inputs.name: cc
inputs.label: CC Address(es)
inputs.helpMarkDown: CC recipient emails. Separate with comma, semicolon, or newline.

inputs.name: bcc
inputs.label: BCC Address(es)
inputs.helpMarkDown: BCC recipient emails. Separate with comma, semicolon, or newline.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.label: Attachment file path(s)
inputs.helpMarkDown: One file path per line. Task fails if any path does not exist.

inputs.name: content
inputs.label: Content template
inputs.helpMarkDown: Email body content. Supports Handlebars expressions.

inputs.name: contentFormat
inputs.label: Content format
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose body format: text, html, or markdown. Markdown is rendered to HTML before send.

inputs.name: templateContext
inputs.label: Template context JSON
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional JSON object merged into template context.

inputs.name: smtpSecure
inputs.label: Use secure connection (TLS)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set true for implicit TLS (usually port 465).

inputs.name: smtpIgnoreTLS
inputs.label: Ignore STARTTLS
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set true to disable STARTTLS upgrade.

inputs.name: smtpRequireTLS
inputs.label: Require STARTTLS
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set true to fail if STARTTLS unavailable.
